title: How a Man of God Stays Close to a Friend Who Walked Away From the Faith
caption:
He used to sit next to you at youth group. Now he says he doesn't believe any of it.

The easy move is to drift, or to turn every hangout into a debate. Neither one is love.

Stay in his life. Ask what happened and listen to all of it. Don't shrink your faith around him. Pray for him by name. Leave the door open for as long as it takes.

The Shepherd leaves the ninety-nine for the one. Luke 15:4

Send this to the brother who's still holding on to a friend like that.

#faith #godlyman #christianmen #friendship #prayer
theme: He's hard on himself, gentle with others.
